The reminder fires at event − 24 h, at least a day after booking; the runtime's timers use the real clock and the verifier's execution budget is under an hour, so the send can't be observed in a twin run. It is exercised with a controlled clock in acme-ops/test/catering-quote.test.ts; here the check above only proves it is scheduled for the right time and not sent early.
Expiry is a signal deadline days after sending; it needs the runtime's clock to advance, which a twin run can't do. Covered with a controlled clock in acme-ops/test/catering-quote.test.ts.

Reply parsing belongs to the inbox intake adapter, outside this runtime (which takes the parsed request or signal). The Gmail twin does not simulate users.history or users.watch, so mailbox-driven intake can't be exercised here.
